ai.title: Init flow auto-starts background processes
ai.summary: CLI init command now triggers automatic background process startup and displays configuration tips after config file creation. `handleInitializationFlowLocally` checks for existing `codebuff.json`, creating it if missing, while `Client` sets `isInitializing` flag to manage post-init feedback. Scope includes `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/inititalization-flow.ts`, `npm-app/src/client.ts`, and `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts`. `logAndHandleStartup` executes configured `startupProcesses` from the newly created or existing config file.

eli5.text: When you run the setup command, the tool now automatically starts any background services you've configured and shows you helpful tips right afterward. If the setup config file already exists, it simply tells you so instead of overwriting it, and it keeps a flag so it knows to display the post-setup guidance once initialization finishes.
